exposure: fibroid enucleation in the anterior wall of the uterus by transverse uterine incision during cesarean section
cohort: 90 pregnant women who underwent myomectomy of the anterior uterine wall during cesarean section at the Second Department of Maternal and Child Health Hospital of Fujian Province
finding: Fibroid enucleation during cesarean section is safe and effective in the anterior wall of the uterus through the lower uterine transverse incision and has the potential to reduce the risk of pelvic and intrauterine adhesions in the future.
mod_finding: Fibroid enucleation during cesarean section through a transverse uterine incision was found to be safe and effective.
